text:
megan: PSA: Nimbus discovered the office mug and is now claiming it as a nap nest. photo attached
memes-bot: uploaded image: nimbus_mug_nap.jpg (640x480)
priyanka: that's the tiniest duvet i've ever seen. hedgehog royalty. :hedgehog: 
samir: rent for that suite pls. i accept micro-payments in snacks. :money_with_wings: 
stella: is that a hand-knit sweater? cinnamon burrito energy. :brown_heart: 
megan: yup, tiny knit. 100% hedgehog-approved after a rigorous sniff test. 
priyanka: quick poll: bring Nimbus to the company picnic this weekend? yes/no
samir: yes. he will be the unofficial morale consultant. 
stella: bringing him will improve meeting efficiency by ~12% (totally precise). :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
memes-bot: reaction :heart_eyes: added by priyanka
megan: logistics note: he's a micro escape artist. i'll bring a travel carrier and extra towels. 
priyanka: can we make a tiny "do not disturb, hedgie napping" sign for the mug? 
samir: on it. i'll mock up a sticker with Nimbus wearing sunglasses. 
stella: new idea: quarterly "hedgehog hours" where he judges architecture diagrams and rolls disapproval. :laughing: 
megan: i'll bring more pics later. thanks for the love, team. Nimbus accepts virtual chin scratches and tiny applause. :paw_prints:
